tasks.label: clang-format: check
tasks.detail: Run git-clang-format from the project .venv with --staged --diff to check formatting of staged files without applying changes.

tasks.label: clang-format-apply
tasks.detail: Run git-clang-format from the project .venv with --staged to apply formatting changes to staged files in-place. Use when user says "clang-format apply", "format staged", "apply clang-format", "git-clang-format apply", or wants to auto-format staged files.
